draft_en.subject: Switch category on setik.biz - two neutral-brand SKUs with listing files
draft_en.body:
Buongiorno,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the switch category on setik.biz, two neutral-brand SKUs with photos and CE files for listing, from single units: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged - STC-028GP - $25.1.

One question: who manages new suppliers at Setik, so I send the listing files to the right person?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
